title: バイオ情報基礎
subtitle: Fundamental Bioinformatics
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) acquire literacy of information technology
(2) learn analysis of gene sequence and phylogenetic tree using mathematical methods
(3) learn how to operate bio-databases
(4) learn analysis of molecular dynamics
advice:
This is a basic bioinformatics course. We will cover the following topics:

1. Information literacy
2. Gene sequence analysis
3. Phylogenetics
4. Phylogenetic tree
5. Bio-databases
6. Protein structure

Students will also learn about advanced issues such as dynamics of proteins, if time permits.
Students are expected to understand the basics of gene sequence analysis.
Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms.
Students are expected to solve the exercises independently.
Students should pay attention to the teacher's instructions in the class because the schedules of quizzes, tests and reports may change as the class progresses.
Students should attend all classes, as the handouts may be not received.
requiredKnowledge:
Knowledge of biochemistry, molecular biology and data analysis.
Sufficient knowledge of bioinformatics (mathematics and physics).
Basic knowledge of biology (gene sequence and protein structure).
How to use a personal computer and internet communication technology.
